sections.text: مقدمة

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to 
be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

تسمح هذه الدائرة بخفض البوابات تحتها 
 الوزن والتحكم فيه من خلال المقاومة المتسلسلة ومولد التيار المستمر لكسر 
 البوابة في موقف الصفر.

The AC control used to lift or lower the intake 
gate in normal operation, this circuit consist of command apparatus limit 
switches and control buttons which control the operation of 4 motors rapid 
lowering used DC control circuit and it works according to over speed protection 
( 175 RPM ), or the local push button in machine hall or in intake.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mohamed Shaaban Al-Behairy, 
 accepted by general director eng. Selem Ahmed Aly, approved by eng. 
 Abd El-kreem Abu Zaid: head 
 sector of High Dam Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC 
quality control general director.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
Switch off the automatic ( AC Power Supply )
Switch off the automatic ( DC Power Supply )
